name: Exaiphanes Blade
description: A longsword that once shone with the Pale Star's light. In the voyager's hand, it becomes a brand-new light that has nothing to do with any past era.

upgrade.0: When the Traveler equips this, their ATK will increase by <color=#99FFFFFF>16%</color> for <color=#99FFFFFF>8</color>s after they hit an opponent. At the same time, they will also regenerate <color=#99FFFFFF>3</color> Elemental Energy. This effect can trigger once every <color=#99FFFFFF>5</color>s. This can be triggered even when the character is not on the field.
upgrade.1: When the Traveler equips this, their CRIT DMG increases by 6% for every Element they have resonated with. Additionally, the Traveler's ATK will also increase by <color=#99FFFFFF>20%</color> for 8s, and regenerate <color=#99FFFFFF>3</color> Elemental Energy, after they attack and hit an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 5s. This can be triggered even when the character is not on the field.
